Fallout 2 Co-op v1.4.0 (https://github.com/gusmarcum/fallout2-coop)

You need your own Fallout 2 (Steam or GOG, US 1.02d) and Windows 10 or 11,
64-bit. Everyone must run the same release of this project with identical game
files.

HOST
1. Copy your Fallout 2 folder somewhere new, for example D:\Games\Fallout2Coop.
   That copy is the co-op world. Use it for co-op only: never start the
   original game from it.
2. Extract this zip into that folder, next to master.dat.
3. Double-click start-server.cmd. The first time, press Enter for a new game.
   After that, Enter continues the newest co-op save.
4. Double-click join.cmd, pick your character name, and leave the address
   empty.

OTHER PLAYERS
Extract this zip into your own Fallout 2 folder, double-click join.cmd, pick
your character name, and enter the host's address (for example their ZeroTier
IP). Your answers are saved in join-settings.cmd; delete it to change them.

Your name is your character: use the same one every time, and a different one
from your friends. Letters, digits, - and _ only.

Keys: T chat, TAB automap, F6/F7 quicksave/quickload (rewinds everyone),
click a player to trade, Use on a dead player to revive them.
Cutscenes play for everyone; the first player to skip one ends it for all.
Experience is shared: every award pays every connected player in full.

Play over a VPN such as ZeroTier. Never forward the game port (9300) to the
internet. If a friend can't connect, check that Windows Firewall on the host
allows f2_server.exe. Windows may warn about an unsigned exe the first time:
More info, then Run anyway.
To stop the server, press F6 in game to quicksave, then close the server window.
